name: A Level Mathematics (OCR A, H240)
material_vintage: OCR A Level Mathematics A (H240) specification, Version 3.1 (August 2026), downloaded from ocr.org.uk on 2026-09-27 and itemised in full: all 193 OCR reference codes (1.01a-3.04c) are items. Assessment: three 2-hour papers of 100 marks each (Paper 1 Pure Mathematics; Paper 2 Pure Mathematics and Statistics; Paper 3 Pure Mathematics and Mechanics), each a third of the A Level; a formula booklet is provided and a calculator is allowed throughout. Stage tests and the mock are original questions in OCR's style; no past-paper items are reproduced. Every numerical answer was computed with sympy when the course was built.
level_source: RQF Level 3 (GCE A Level), per Ofqual's register listing for OCR H240

learner_notices.text: OCR's Paper 2 assumes familiarity with OCR's pre-released large data set (published on the OCR website with its metadata). Download it and explore it alongside S22; exam questions may use its context.
OCR expects a calculator that can compute binomial and normal probabilities (including inverse normal) and summary statistics. Have one from S22 onwards.
